description: Synthetic: a long Claude Code coordinator screen relaying page feedback to background agents. Every turn ends "✻ Waiting for N background agents to finish"; the last one has Claude Code's update notice between that line and its own empty input box, one shell in the footer, and two agent rows below with elapsed time and tokens. The notice is chrome under the turn: the turn waits on its agents, so the pane is waiting on external (shown as Working) and both workers are running.
